segs.en: E. Extradimensional Cosmic Phenomenon

zh.ai: E. 超维宇宙现象

segs.en: The Intergalactic Cosmic Phenomenon Containment (ICPC) has reported a surge in Breach-Level Unstable Events (BLUEs) — rare extradimensional disturbances that manifest as rift points in local spacetime. If left unchecked, these anomalies may cascade into a full-scale reality fracture, erasing the timeline of the entire universe.

zh.ai: 星际宇宙现象遏制组织（ICPC）报告称，突破级不稳定事件（BLUE）数量激增。这些罕见的异次元扰动会以局部时空裂隙点的形式出现。若不加以控制，这些异常现象可能级联为大规模现实断裂，抹除整个宇宙的时间线。

segs.en: To address this crisis, the ICPC has deployed $$$N$$$ Anomaly Regulation Centers (ARCs). Each ARC must be assigned a set of BLUEs to stabilize, under the following conditions:

zh.ai: 为应对这场危机，ICPC 已部署 $$$N$$$ 个异常调控中心(ARCs)。每个 ARC 都必须分配一组需要稳定的 BLUEs，并满足以下条件：

segs.en: There are $$$X$$$ Type-Alpha BLUEs, each requiring exactly 1 unit of energy to stabilize.

zh.ai: 有 $$$X$$$ 个 Alpha 型 BLUE，每个恰好需要 1 单位能量才能稳定。

segs.en: There are $$$Y$$$ Type-Omega BLUEs, each requiring exactly 2 units of energy to stabilize.

zh.ai: 有 $$$Y$$$ 个 Type-Omega BLUE，每个都恰好需要 2 单位能量才能稳定。

segs.en: Each BLUE must be assigned entirely to exactly one ARC (no splitting or sharing). An ARC may stabilize multiple BLUEs, but the total required energy for its assigned anomalies must be drawn from its own reservoir.

zh.ai: 每个 BLUE 必须完整地分配给且仅分配给一个 ARC（不得拆分或共享）。一个 ARC 可以稳定多个 BLUE，但为其所分配异常所需的总能量必须来自它自身的储备。

segs.en: To maintain synchronization across containment protocols, the ICPC mandates that the energy loads be distributed as evenly as possible among the ARCs.

zh.ai: 为了维持各项收容协议之间的同步，ICPC 要求将能量负载尽可能均匀地分配到各个 ARC 中。

segs.en: Your task is to determine the minimum possible energy imbalance, defined as the difference between the maximum energy assigned to any ARC and the minimum energy assigned to any ARC.

zh.ai: 你的任务是确定最小可能的能量不平衡，即分配给任意 ARC 的最大能量与分配给任意 ARC 的最小能量之差。

segs.en: The first line contains a single integer $$$T$$$ — the number of test cases. ($$$1 \le T \le 1000$$$)

zh.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 $$$T$$$，表示测试用例的数量。($$$1 \le T \le 1000$$$)

segs.en: The next $$$T$$$ lines each contain three integers $$$X, Y, N$$$. ($$$0 \le X, Y \le 10^9$$$, $$$2 \le N \le 10^6$$$) — the number of Type-Alpha BLUEs, the number of Type-Omega BLUEs, and the number of Anomaly Regulation Centers (ARCs).

zh.ai: 接下来的 $$$T$$$ 行中，每行包含三个整数 $$$X, Y, N$$$。($$$0 \le X, Y \le 10^9$$$、$$$2 \le N \le 10^6$$$) —— Type-Alpha BLUE 的数量、Type-Omega BLUE 的数量以及异常调节中心(ARC)的数量。

segs.en: For each test case, output a single integer — the minimum possible difference between the maximum energy assigned to any ARC and the minimum energy assigned to any ARC.

zh.ai: 对于每组测试用例，输出一个整数——分配给任意 ARC 的最大能量与分配给任意 ARC 的最小能量之差的最小可能值。

segs.en: In the first case, the distribution can be as follows:

zh.ai: 在第一种情况下，分配可以如下：

segs.en: The first ARC takes $$$2$$$ Type-Alpha BLUEs.

zh.ai: 第一条 ARC 需要 $$$2$$$ 个 Type-Alpha BLUE。

segs.en: The second and third ARCs each take $$$1$$$ Type-Omega BLUE.

zh.ai: 第二个和第三个 ARC 各需要 $$$1$$$ 个 Type-Omega BLUE。

segs.en: They all spent two energy units, so the difference is $$$0$$$.

zh.ai: 他们都消耗了两个能量单位，因此差值是 $$$0$$$。

segs.en: In the second case, the distribution can be as follows:

zh.ai: 在第二种情况下，分配方案可以如下：

segs.en: The first ARC takes $$$1$$$ Type-Alpha BLUE and $$$1$$$ Type-Omega BLUE.

zh.ai: 第一个 ARC 获取 $$$1$$$ Type-Alpha BLUE 和 $$$1$$$ Type-Omega BLUE。

segs.en: The second takes $$$2$$$ Type-Omega BLUEs.

zh.ai: 第二个需要 $$$2$$$ 个 Type-Omega BLUE。

segs.en: The third takes $$$1$$$ Type-Omega BLUE.

zh.ai: 第三个需要 $$$1$$$ 个欧米伽型蓝色。

segs.en: The difference is $$$3$$$ (the first ARC) $$$- 1$$$ (the third ARC) $$$= 2$$$. It can be shown that this is the optimal assignment.

zh.ai: 差值为 $$$3$$$(第一个 ARC)$$$- 1$$$(第三个 ARC)$$$= 2$$$。可以证明这是最优分配。

segs.en: C. Quantum Beaver

zh.ai: C. 量子海狸

segs.en: Busy Beaver lived on an unpainted sidewalk consisting of $$$N$$$ individual tiles numbered $$$1,2,\dots,N$$$ from left to right. The tiles all start with the factory-standard color $$$0$$$, but Busy Beaver is looking to change that! Over several days of painting, Busy Beaver aims to repaint the entire sidewalk.

zh.ai: 忙碌的海狸生活在人行道上，这条人行道由 $$$N$$$ 块未涂漆的瓷砖组成，瓷砖从左到右编号为 $$$1,2,\dots,N$$$。所有瓷砖的初始颜色均为出厂标准色 $$$0$$$，但忙碌的海狸想要改变这一点！经过数天的涂漆，忙碌的海狸打算重新粉刷整条人行道。

segs.en: Specifically, Busy Beaver wrote down a list of $$$Q$$$ plans, the $$$i$$$-th of which states that on day $$$d_i$$$ ($$$0 \le d_i \le 2^K-1$$$), Busy Beaver will repaint all tiles in the range $$$[x_i, y_i]$$$ with color $$$c_i$$$, overwriting their previous colors. Busy Beaver has at most one painting plan scheduled for each day, and he is interested in the sum of the final colors of all tiles after all the repaintings.

zh.ai: 具体来说，Busy Beaver 写下了 $$$Q$$$ 个计划，其中第 $$$i$$$ 个计划规定，在第 $$$d_i$$$ 天($$$0 \le d_i \le 2^K-1$$$)，Busy Beaver 将把范围 $$$[x_i, y_i]$$$ 内的所有方块重新涂成颜色 $$$c_i$$$，覆盖它们之前的颜色。Busy Beaver 每天至多安排一个涂色计划，他想知道所有重新涂色操作完成后所有方块最终颜色之和。

segs.en: Unbeknownst to Busy Beaver, he is, in fact, the first Beaver to live in a Quantum Computer! This unfortunately means that the universe does not operate as he thinks it does. During the night, while no one is watching, the qubits undergo a random transformation: an integer $$$z$$$ between $$$0$$$ and $$$2^K - 1$$$ is selected, and every plan originally scheduled for day $$$i$$$ is instead moved to day $$$i \oplus z$$$, where $$$\oplus$$$ denotes bitwise XOR.

zh.ai: Busy Beaver 并不知道，他其实是第一只生活在量子计算机中的海狸！不幸的是，这意味着宇宙并不像他想象的那样运作。夜里，在无人观察时，量子比特会发生一次随机变换：随机选取一个介于 $$$0$$$ 和 $$$2^K - 1$$$ 之间的整数 $$$z$$$，并将原定于第 $$$i$$$ 天的所有计划改到第 $$$i \oplus z$$$ 天，其中 $$$\oplus$$$ 表示按位异或。

segs.en: For a given $$$z$$$, the plans are then executed in increasing order of their (shifted) day, and each repaint operation overwrites the colors of the tiles between $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$. Let $$$F(z)$$$ be the sum of the final colors of all tiles after applying the plans with shift $$$z$$$.

zh.ai: 对于给定的 $$$z$$$，随后按照计划对应的(偏移后的)日期递增顺序执行这些计划，每次重新着色操作都会覆盖 $$$x_i$$$ 和 $$$y_i$$$ 之间所有方格的颜色。令 $$$F(z)$$$ 表示将偏移量为 $$$z$$$ 的计划应用后，所有方格最终颜色之和。

segs.en: Compute $$${\large \sum_{z=0}^{2^K - 1}} F(z)$$$. Since the answer may be enormous, output it modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.

zh.ai: 计算 $$${\large \sum_{z=0}^{2^K - 1}} F(z)$$$。由于答案可能非常大，请输出其对 $$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

segs.en: Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line contains the number of test cases $$$T$$$ ($$$1\leq T\leq 150$$$). The description of the test cases follows.

zh.ai: 每个测试包含多组测试用例。第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$T$$$($$$1\leq T\leq 150$$$)。接下来是各测试用例的描述。

segs.en: The first line of each test case contains three integers $$$N$$$, $$$K$$$, and $$$Q$$$ ($$$1\leq N\leq 2\cdot10^5$$$, $$$0\leq K\leq60$$$, $$$1\leq Q\leq \min(2^K,2\cdot 10^5)$$$).

zh.ai: 每个测试用例的第一行包含三个整数 $$$N$$$、$$$K$$$ 和 $$$Q$$$($$$1\leq N\leq 2\cdot10^5$$$、$$$0\leq K\leq60$$$、$$$1\leq Q\leq \min(2^K,2\cdot 10^5)$$$)。

segs.en: The $$$i$$$-th of the next $$$Q$$$ lines contains four integers $$$d_i$$$, $$$x_i$$$, $$$y_i$$$, and $$$c_i$$$ ($$$0\leq d_i \lt 2^K$$$, $$$1\leq x_i\leq y_i\leq N$$$, $$$0\leq c_i\leq10^9$$$).

It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$N$$$ across all test cases is at most $$$4\cdot10^5$$$, the sum of $$$Q$$$ across all test cases is at most $$$4\cdot10^5$$$, and all $$$d_i$$$'s within a test case are distinct.

zh.ai: 保证所有测试用例中 $$$N$$$ 之和至多为 $$$4\cdot10^5$$$，所有测试用例中 $$$Q$$$ 之和至多为 $$$4\cdot10^5$$$，且同一测试用例内的所有 $$$d_i$$$ 互不相同。

segs.en: For each test case, output one integer on its own line: the sum of the answers to Busy Beaver's original question over all $$$2^K$$$ possible shifts, modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.

zh.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出一个整数，表示在所有 $$$2^K$$$ 种可能的平移下，Busy Beaver 的原始问题的答案之和对 $$$10^9+7$$$ 取模的结果。

segs.en: There are five subtasks for this problem.

zh.ai: 本题有五个子任务。

segs.en: ($$$10$$$ points): The sum of $$$N$$$, $$$2^K$$$, and $$$Q$$$ over all test cases are each less than or equal to $$$5 \cdot 10^3$$$. Note that this refers to each of the individual sums, not the cumulative sum of all of them. Also, $$$c_i \le 5 \cdot 10^3$$$ for all $$$i$$$.

zh.ai: ($$$10$$$ 分)：对于所有测试用例，$$$N$$$、$$$2^K$$$ 和 $$$Q$$$ 的总和分别都小于或等于 $$$5 \cdot 10^3$$$。注意，这指的是每个单独的总和，而不是它们的累计总和。此外，对于所有 $$$i$$$，都有 $$$c_i \le 5 \cdot 10^3$$$。

segs.en: ($$$20$$$ points): For all test cases, $$$N=1, Q \le 2$$$.
($$$20$$$ points): For all test cases, $$$N=1$$$.
($$$20$$$ points): For all test cases, $$$K\leq 18$$$.
($$$30$$$ points): No further constraints.
M. Binary String Counting 2026

zh.ai: M. 二进制字符串计数 2026

segs.en: Yes, this is yet another problem about counting binary strings.

zh.ai: 是的，这又是一道关于计数二进制字符串的题目。

segs.en: You are given a string $$$s$$$ consisting of $$$n$$$ characters; each character is either 1 or 0. Also, you are given an integer $$$k$$$.

zh.ai: 给定一个由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串 $$$s$$$；每个字符要么是 1，要么是 0。此外，给定一个整数 $$$k$$$。

segs.en: You can perform up to $$$k$$$ (possibly zero) operations on string $$$s$$$. Each operation has to be of one of three types:

zh.ai: 你可以对字符串 $$$s$$$ 执行至多 $$$k$$$ 次(也可以是零次)操作。每次操作必须属于以下三种类型之一：

segs.en: choose an index $$$i$$$ from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$ and replace $$$s_i$$$ with its inverse (that is, if $$$s_i$$$ is 1, replace it with 0, and vice versa);

zh.ai: 选择一个从 $$$1$$$ 到 $$$n$$$ 的下标 $$$i$$$，并将 $$$s_i$$$ 替换为其相反值(即若 $$$s_i$$$ 为 1，则将其替换为 0，反之亦然)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-descending order (assuming that 1 is greater than 0);

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 的字符按非递减顺序排序(假设 1 大于 0)；

segs.en: sort the characters of the string $$$s$$$ in non-ascending order (also assuming that 1 is greater than 0).

zh.ai: 将字符串 $$$s$$$ 中的字符按非升序排序(并规定 1 大于 0)。

segs.en: String $$$t$$$ is reachable if it is possible to obtain it from $$$s$$$ by applying no more than $$$k$$$ operations. You have to calculate the number of reachable strings $$$t$$$.
The first line contains two integers $$$n$$$ and $$$k$$$ ($$$1 \le n \le 150$$$; $$$0 \le k \le n$$$).
The second line contains $$$s$$$ — a string consisting of exactly $$$n$$$ characters. Each character is either 1 or 0.

zh.ai: 第二行包含 $$$s$$$ —— 一个恰好由 $$$n$$$ 个字符组成的字符串。每个字符都是 1 或 0。

segs.en: Print one integer — the number of reachable strings. Since the answer can be huge, print it modulo $$$998244353$$$.

zh.ai: 输出一个整数——可达字符串的数量。由于答案可能很大，请输出答案对 $$$998244353$$$ 取模的结果。
